definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being safe. Used to discuss how safe something is, rather than the state of being safe.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This car has a high level of safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To verify the safety of food products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}される→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The new medicine cannot be sold until its safety is confirmed.

notes:
{安全性|あんぜんせい} refers to the abstract quality or degree of being safe, used when discussing levels or assessments of safety rather than simply the state of being safe. It is formed from ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (safe) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature/quality), where the ～⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ suffix converts adjectives or nouns into abstract quality nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — high/low safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to ensure safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ — to confirm safety
- {安全性|あんぜんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — there is a safety concern

CONTRAST WITH {安全|あんぜん}:
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ — safe (state or condition)
- {安全性|あんぜんせい} — safety (the measurable quality/degree of being safe)
